Evidence

Verification and limitations

What the checks establish

  • Defective built-ins starter: exactly 3/7 checks pass and the four specified failures are assertion failures, not checker crashes.
  • Defective Spec Kit starter: exactly 2/10 checks pass and the eight specified failures are assertion failures.
  • Authored references pass 7/7 and 10/10. Learner test suites pass on repaired code and fail on the original implementation.
  • Empty-cart and no-code behavior, integer boundaries, invalid input, non-stacking, duplicate handling, inclusive expiry and catalogue preservation are checked deterministically, without a model or network.
  • Setup refuses existing learner work. The built-ins starter contains no .github/prompts or substitute slash commands.
  • The Spec Kit installer verifies nine official command or skill entries.
  • Lab 2 setup installs ten complete upstream skill folders from five pinned repositories (obra/superpowers, mattpocock/skills, addyosmani/agent-skills, blader/humanizer, anthropics/skills) and six original engineering skills. The 29 upstream files and six lab-authored skill files are checked against separate SHA-256 manifests; upstream licenses are preserved, and no upstream scripts or hooks are installed.
  • The public-skills track deliberately reuses the cart fixture in a fresh workspace: 3/7 baseline, 7/7 reference. It adds skill-integrity checks to the existing scope gate, not a new set of seven distinct business requirements. The review-feedback and PR-description practice files can be edited freely; the checks do not grade how well /receiving-code-review, /humanizer or /grill-me were followed.

Media provenance

The recorder reruns starter and reference checks before generating each GIF. The displayed baseline and final check output comes from those runs. Prompts, intermediate answers and feature documents are authored illustrations, not captured live Copilot or Spec Kit responses.

Each GIF has still posters, a text transcript, looping animation and a checksum in the media manifest. Animation decoding and site/browser checks are separate from exercise checks.

Not established by automation

  • Live Copilot entitlement, sign-in, command discovery or behavior on a participant's client; verify these in its / picker during preflight.
  • That a real agent will produce the reference solution or the same dialogue.
  • That the /security-review exercise identifies real attack paths or establishes production security; it is a bounded fixture exercise with no network, database or authorization sink.
  • That the dependency exercise audits a real vulnerable package; the learner workspace intentionally has no application dependencies or lockfile.
  • That the migration scenario reflects a live database; it is hypothetical, and the profiling benchmark is synthetic.
  • Semantic completeness merely because spec/plan/tasks files exist.
  • Screen-reader output, real phones or browsers other than the tested browser.
  • Hosted deployment of local edits, or any measured productivity improvement.

Commands and skills guide an agent. Independent tests and human review decide whether the work is complete.

Two-lab restructure: observed validation, 2026-11-01

The workshop was reorganized into one lab/ environment with two labs: Lab 1 (/commands + Spec Kit, 6 GIFs) and Lab 2 (anti-slop skills, 4 GIFs, including a new built-in skill discovery scene). The older optional commands/, skills/ and practice/ trees were removed.

Check Observed result
Lab tests (npm test in lab) 14 passed: track baselines and references, setup refusal, weak-test rejection, scope checks, upstream skill copying and tamper detection
GIF tooling (lab/tools) Encoder tests 2 passed; all 10 GIFs verified: 12 distinct frames, 23.6-second loop, checksum, posters and transcript
Site build and check 17 pages up to date; every link, asset and anchor resolves; no raw Markdown links; three ZIPs match a fresh build
Bundle tests 3 passed: deterministic clean ZIPs; skills ZIP matches the pinned hashes; extracted lab runs setup, red baseline, overwrite refusal and 7/7 repair for builtins and superpowers
Browser smoke (Chromium) 17 pages, 23 images, 21 players; no errors, remote requests or overflow at 320, 768, 1024 and 1440 pixels; home routes to both labs and all three downloads; every lab GIF plays full screen and returns focus; copy, clipboard error, theater and skip link work

Genuine Spec Kit installation was not rerun for this restructure; the earlier record below covers it. No prompt was sent to a live Copilot model, and the hosted site is only updated when these changes are pushed to main.
